verdict.rationale: Ghostty's own docs state that on macOS it has built-in window state recovery on restart, so it directly supports restoring windows after a restart. The evidence is a single passing mention, limited to macOS, and does not detail what state is restored. Missing for 10: explicit restoration of tabs/splits, restoration of working directories, recovery after a crash (versus a clean restart), Linux support, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can restore my windows, tabs, and working directories after a restart or crash

citations.quote: on macOS, Ghostty supports Quick Look, force touch, the macOS secure input API, built-in window state recovery on restart, etc.
